description: Vendor-native lanes for the nativeVendors parameter. Each entry selects that vendor's Abstract events, unpacks event.original into the columns the vendor's Microsoft Sentinel connector expects, and runs Microsoft's published transformation for that connector into the vendor's table. Okta: the route generated and lab-proven on 2026-09-28, Microsoft Azure-Sentinel at the ref below, MIT licence (see NOTICE). Do not edit by hand. selectKql is the lane's own event selection, reused to keep those events out of the ASIM dataflows; it must stay identical to the where clause in transformKql (tools/sentinel-solution/test_solution.py checks it).

vendors.name: okta
